definitions.explanation: A cooperative financial institution that serves members within a specific local area, providing savings accounts, loans, and other banking services primarily to small businesses and individuals.

examples.japanese: {信用金庫|しんようきんこ}に{預金|よきん}した。
examples.english: I deposited money at the credit union.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{信用金庫|しんようきんこ}から{融資|ゆうし}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a loan from the local credit union.

examples.japanese: この{信用金庫|しんようきんこ}は{地域|ちいき}の{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}を{支援|しえん}することを{目的|もくてき}としている。
examples.english: This credit union aims to support small and medium businesses in the area.

notes:
A type of cooperative financial institution ({協同組織|きょうどうそしき}) unique to Japan's financial system. Unlike banks, {信用金庫|しんようきんこ} are member-owned and focused on serving local communities. Often abbreviated to {信金|しんきん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信用金庫|しんようきんこ}に{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}く: to open an account at a credit union
- {地元|じもと}の{信用金庫|しんようきんこ}: local credit union
- {信金|しんきん}: abbreviated form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう}: bank (larger, publicly traded, nationwide)
- {信用組合|しんようくみあい}: credit cooperative (even smaller scale than {信用金庫|しんようきんこ})
- {農協|のうきょう}: agricultural cooperative (serves farmers specifically)
